name: leakage-safe-model-selection
cohort_rule: Product has at least one recorded sale on or before the tuning cutoff. Freeze cohort before reading selection-window targets. Build each 90-day context with zero recorded sales on dates without transactions.

selection.missing_transaction_dates: zero recorded sales; this does not distinguish zero demand from unavailable or discontinued products

test.status: Previously reused; descriptive only and excluded from model selection

prediction_policy: Use each model's documented point forecast; clamp negative sales forecasts to zero.

resource_limits.inference_batch_size: Per-model, fixed before scoring and recorded in run metadata

selection_policy: Choose on pooled validation MAE as the primary metric, inspect RMSE and WAPE as guardrails, and report latency separately. Compare only identical product-date keys.
